video_title: God Shammgod 1-on-1 Interview with Andrew Lopez | New Orleans Pelicans

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on his new role as Pelicans Summer League head coach
quotes.excerpt: It just shows the belief Joe Dumars and Jamal Mosley have in me
quotes.quote: It is super exciting. I have been in the NBA for about 11 years now, and I have been to Summer League probably nine times where I was assistant coach. For me to be at the head for this summer and have this great opportunity with the Pelicans, it just shows the belief Joe Dumars and Jamal Mosley have in me and the organization has in me to lead this group of young men to play hard, to play unselfish, and to play new style of Pelicans basketball.

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on implementing his coaching philosophy with the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I know he is all about hard work, he is all about dedication, and he is big on unselfishness
quotes.quote: Having a long relationship with coach Jamal Mosley, I know he is all about hard work, he is all about dedication, and he is big on unselfishness. All the teams that I have been on have been about that. When he was the head coach, that is what our team was based on. Atlanta was a great defensive team, and when we were in Dallas together, we were a great defensive team and we played unselfish. We probably had the number one ranked offense, and in Atlanta, he was the top five defense. So, that is basically what we are going to bring here and implement, and I am just an extension of him.

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on working with Zion Williamson during the offseason
quotes.excerpt: Zion is amongst the few of great talented players
quotes.quote: For a lot of people that know my history and my backstory, I work with a lot of talented players, and Zion is amongst the few of great talented players. Since I have been here, all he wants to do is work hard and do all the things he needs to do to be the player that he knows he is and put on for the Pelican fans and the organization. I feel this year is a great year to do that with everything being new and everything being a fresh start.

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on the competitive nature of Jeremiah Robinson-Earl
quotes.excerpt: He has kind of the Kobe mentality, just want to work hard, work hard all the time
quotes.quote: Working with him, working with Fears, seeing DQ, and seeing the competitive nature Fears is from afar, he has kind of the Kobe mentality, just want to work hard, work hard all the time, which is a great thing for a young player. Especially the position that he is playing, it is a point guard, one of the hardest positions in the NBA. Between him and Dejounte Murray, and I knew Dejounte since he was like 15 years old, everybody is ready to work hard and just get this thing up and going.

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on the challenges of playing point guard in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The position he is in is the toughest position in the NBA
quotes.quote: The position he is in is the toughest position in the NBA because you have to make sure you are okay and you have to lead men, whether they are older than you or whether they are the same age. For me, it is just me to bring my experience for me being a point guard in the NBA and playing at the highest level, it is just helping him be able to navigate the ups and downs. I am just working on and sharpening all the skills he already has. My job as a coach is to bring what is out of them to the light.

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on the work ethic of Jaron Pierre
quotes.excerpt: He is such a hard worker, like I mean really, really hard worker
quotes.quote: From him as a player, he is such a hard worker, like I mean really, really hard worker. And you know in the NBA of basketball, we have a term where we like, man, he is a dog, he is a dog, he is a dog. He is really a dog. Like he goes hard, he is going to come in here and give all he got. And the most important thing about him is, if you look at his history and his track record, he is a big communicator.
